setup_batch_predict_server: setup a Ray Serve deployment for batched MLIP inference with configurable batch size and replicas
BatchPredictServer_predict: predict on a batch of AtomicData objects with automatic OOM batch splitting and retry
BatchPredictServer_call: call the batch predict server with a single AtomicData object to get predictions
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual system predictions based on per-system or per-atom shape
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the maximum batch size and wait timeout for the batch predict server
